tara: Heads upfound a wrapped service account blob in partner staging backups: `gs://partner-backups/staging/2026-04-02/backup-q9e7.json.gz`. It contains a SA email: redwood-staging-backup-sa@redwood-staging.iam.gserviceaccount.com. Blob metadata shows partner KMS key `projects/partner-project/locations/global/keyRings/backups/cryptoKeys/wrap-2025`.

miguel: Is it plaintext or wrapped ciphertext?

tara: Wrapped ciphertext (can't read private_key here) but SA identity is visible in the JSON metadata. Treat as compromised for now.

sec-bot: alert: sensitive_artifact_upload matched SA key pattern. severity=medium. detected=2026-04-02T09:12:21Z.

oncall: Opening incident SOM-2026-142. Containment steps: 1) restrict object ACLs 2) snapshot copy to evidence bucket (read-only) 3) request KMS unwrap audit from partner 4) start SA key rotation in staging.

aj: Immediate asks for partner: - share Cloud KMS audit log entries for decrypt/unwrap on `wrap-2025` for last 30 days - list principals with decrypt/unwrap roles on that key - temporarily remove any broad decrypt grants.

partner-sec: Received. We'll pull logs and IAM bindings, block wide decrypt roles and reply with CSV within 90m.

miguel: Internal tasks: - miguel: prepare service account rotation TF plan & CI update (ETA 1.5h) - tara: repo and artifact scan for duplicates (ETA 30m) - oncall: attach evidence snapshot to SOM-2026-142.

tara: Quick grep found two references in staging terraform state and one CI job `ci/staging-snapshot`. No prod references.

aj: Note: rotating partner KMS key doesn't protect already wrapped blobs we don't control. Assume any principal with Unwrap can decrypt. Prioritize SA rotation and token revocation.

oncall: Marking incident as contained for now (staging only) pending partner audit. After partner response: rotate SA keys, update TF & CI, request partner rotate wrap key if needed, and run RBAC hardening for partners.

partner-sec: Logs pulled. We see 3 decrypt calls in last 60 days from `serviceAccount:partner-backup-runner@partner-project.iam.gserviceaccount.com`. We'll provide IAM snapshot and export decrypt events to a shared bucket for your SIEM.

miguel: Thanks. Plan to create new SA, import keyless creds into CI via workload identity, remove long-lived keys, and patch TF state. Will include step to migrate to Workload Identity for CI to avoid storing SA keys.

tara: Good plan. Also adding vendor onboarding requirement: KMS audit forwarding or key-access SLA.

sec-bot: Reminder: attach all communications to SOM-2026-142 and evidence bucket.

oncall: Closing interim containment. Pls update ticket with final rotation artifacts and post-incident RBAC checklist.
